explanation: Speeding BUS 11-20 km/h over (bus-specific limit) -> 5.000 RSD
Speeding BUS 21-50 km/h over -> 10-20k RSD + 4 points + 30 days ban
Speeding BUS 51-70 km/h over -> 20-40k RSD OR prison <= 30 days + 7 points + 4 months ban
Speeding BUS > 70 km/h over -> 100-120k RSD OR prison >= 15 days + 14 points + 8 months ban
